services.desc: Avalon Hollywood is not just a historic landmark; it’s a premier destination for live entertainment and special events. Every week, we host a variety of live music shows that draw in crowds from all over the world. From cutting-edge electronic music to live bands, our venue offers something for everyone. With two distinct areas, Avalon and Bardot, we provide versatile spaces that can be tailored to suit any event, whether you’re planning an intimate gathering or a large-scale production. Our state-of-the-art facilities and experienced team ensure that every event at Avalon Hollywood is unforgettable.
